Weakness(Greater Day): This creature suffers numerous adverse effects during the daytime. When the sun is up in the area that this entity inhabits, their Strength, Agility, and Vitality are all reduced to 5. This being cannot use any powers during this time, nor can they use any Magical or Divine Magical skills. They is also unable to move whatsoever during this time. These negatives apply from the time the sun rises until the sun sets. The creature need not be exposed to sunlight for these penalties to be in effect. Note: The skills Life Sense, Telepathy, and Thought Projection are unaffected by this Disability.

These negatives apply from the time the sun rises until the sun sets. The creature need not be exposed to sunlight for these penalties to be in effect. Note: The skills Life Sense, Telepathy, and Thought Projection are unaffected by this Disability.
